build_compute_scores: build compute_scores to cross-validate PCA and FactorAnalysis models across a range of component counts
create_shrunk_cov_score: create shrunk_cov_score to find optimal shrinkage via GridSearchCV for ShrunkCovariance estimator
test_lw_score: test lw_score to compute cross-validated likelihood for the LedoitWolf covariance estimator
run_pca_mle: run PCA with n_components='mle' to automatically estimate optimal dimensionality from data
compare_fa_pca_scores: compare FactorAnalysis and PCA cross-validation scores to select best model for noisy data
